title: Automation & Control Engineer — CLC Production Plants
description: Develop and commission controls for batching, mixing, pumping and foaming equipment.
responsibilities: Program PLC sequences, interlocks, alarms and HMI screens for automated CLC production.
Integrate load cells, level sensors, flow meters, motors and variable-frequency drives.
Prepare I/O lists, control-panel drawings, test procedures and operator instructions.
Troubleshoot plant faults and support commissioning alongside fabrication and production teams.
qualification: Electrical, electronics or mechatronics degree; a relevant technical diploma with strong commissioning experience is also suitable.
experience: 3+ years in industrial automation; hands-on PLC commissioning is essential.
skills: Motor control, instrumentation and electrical schematic reading
Safe isolation, fault finding and commissioning documentation
tools: Siemens TIA Portal / WinCC or equivalent PLC/HMI platform
VFD configuration and industrial communications such as Modbus

title: Mechanical Design Engineer — Mixing & Batching Equipment
description: Design manufacturable mixers, frames, tanks, conveyors and plant assemblies.
responsibilities: Create fabrication drawings, assemblies and bills of materials.
Select motors, gearboxes, bearings and drive components for mixing equipment.
Check clearances, maintenance access, weld details and fabrication tolerances.
Work with the workshop to resolve fit-up issues and update drawings after trials.
qualification: Mechanical engineering degree or mechanical design diploma with an equipment-design portfolio.
skills: Steel fabrication, shaft and bearing selection
BOM preparation and design revision control

title: MIG / MAG Welder — Plant Frames & Assemblies
description: Fabricate welded steel structures and assemblies for Nanolite production equipment.
responsibilities: Read fabrication drawings and prepare steel joints.
Set welding parameters and produce consistent MIG/MAG welds.
Control distortion, inspect finished welds and correct defects.
Maintain welding equipment and follow workshop PPE and hot-work procedures.
qualification: Welding trade certificate preferred; practical experience and a successful welding test can substitute. A high-school diploma is not mandatory.
experience: 2+ years welding steel frames, machinery or industrial assemblies.
skills: Joint preparation and weld defect recognition
Safe handling of grinders, gas cylinders and welding equipment

title: TIG Welder — Stainless Tanks & Pipework
description: Produce clean stainless-steel tank, pipe and fitting welds for process equipment.
responsibilities: Prepare and fit stainless components without contamination.
Perform TIG welds with appropriate shielding and purging.
Check joints for finish, alignment and leaks.
Record completed work and coordinate repairs with quality inspection.
qualification: TIG welding trade training preferred; demonstrated skill in a practical test is acceptable without a formal diploma.
experience: 2+ years TIG welding stainless sheet, tanks or pipework.

title: Fabrication Fitter — CLC Plant Assembly
description: Fit and assemble mechanical equipment from production drawings.
responsibilities: Mark, cut, drill and fit structural steel and fabricated parts.
Align shafts, motors, gearboxes and bearings.
Assemble guards, platforms, tanks and bolted plant sections.
Check dimensions and report drawing or component mismatches.
qualification: Mechanical fitting trade certificate or equivalent workshop experience. Formal schooling is not essential if practical skills are demonstrated.
experience: 2+ years fitting fabricated machinery or industrial structures.
tools: Drill press, grinders and hand tools
Vernier calipers, levels and alignment tools

title: Electromechanical Maintenance Technician — Production Equipment
description: Keep mixers, pumps, drives and production machinery reliable.
responsibilities: Perform planned maintenance and diagnose mechanical or electrical faults.
Inspect bearings, belts, couplings, motors and control components.
Maintain breakdown records and recommend critical spare parts.
Isolate machinery safely and verify operation after repairs.
qualification: Electrical or mechanical technical diploma, trade certificate or equivalent industrial maintenance experience.
experience: 3+ years maintaining factory machinery; motor-control fault finding preferred.
skills: Mechanical repair and basic electrical diagnostics
tools: Excel or a maintenance management system

title: Production Supervisor — CLC Mixing & Block Manufacturing
description: Coordinate daily CLC batches, moulding, curing and production quality.
responsibilities: Plan shift work around batching, mould availability and curing requirements.
Check mix records, batch consistency and finished block dimensions.
Train operators and coordinate material supply and equipment readiness.
Record output, rejects and downtime; escalate safety and quality issues.
qualification: Production or mechanical technical diploma preferred; proven CLC or concrete production supervision may substitute.
experience: 3+ years in concrete or process manufacturing, including shift supervision.
skills: Batch record control and material coordination
People supervision and practical quality checks
Production reporting and safe operating procedures

title: Factory Operations Manager — Fabrication & CLC Plants
description: Manage workshop and production delivery, capacity, maintenance and quality.
responsibilities: Schedule fabrication and manufacturing work against delivery commitments.
Coordinate supervisors, maintenance, materials and quality inspection.
Track capacity, rework, downtime and production costs.
Set practical safety standards and improve workshop flow and equipment availability.
qualification: Engineering or manufacturing qualification preferred; substantial factory leadership experience may substitute.
experience: 5+ years in industrial manufacturing, including at least 2 years managing production teams.
skills: Inventory coordination and operational cost control

title: Manufacturing Project Manager — Plant Build & Commissioning
description: Deliver CLC equipment projects from approved drawings through build, testing and handover.
responsibilities: Build project schedules, budgets and material delivery plans.
Coordinate design, procurement, fabrication and factory acceptance testing.
Track technical changes, risks and supplier delays.
Arrange commissioning and prepare handover documents and operator training.
qualification: Mechanical, electrical or industrial engineering qualification, or equivalent machinery-project delivery experience.
experience: 4+ years delivering industrial machinery or plant projects.
tools: CAD drawing review and document-control tools

title: Procurement Specialist — Industrial Components & Steel
description: Source the components and materials required to fabricate and maintain CLC production equipment.
responsibilities: Purchase steel, motors, gearboxes, pumps, bearings and control components to approved specifications.
Compare technical quotations, lead times and total delivered costs.
Track purchase orders and coordinate incoming inspections.
Maintain supplier records and resolve missing, incorrect or delayed items.
qualification: Relevant diploma or degree preferred; proven technical purchasing experience is acceptable.
experience: 3+ years buying industrial materials, machinery components or electrical controls.

title: Quality Inspector — Fabrication & Plant Assembly
description: Verify fabricated parts and assembled plant equipment before dispatch.
responsibilities: Check dimensions, fit-up, weld finish and assembly against drawings.
Document inspection results and identify non-conforming parts.
Witness functional checks and support factory acceptance testing.
Verify corrective work and maintain traceable inspection records.
qualification: Mechanical or manufacturing diploma preferred; experienced fabrication inspectors may qualify without a degree. Welding inspection training is an advantage.
experience: 2+ years inspecting steel fabrication or machinery assemblies.
tools: Vernier calipers, micrometers and weld gauges

title: Production & Workshop Helper — Entry Level
description: Support trained operators and fabricators with materials preparation and workshop housekeeping.
responsibilities: Prepare and move materials using approved handling methods.
Assist with mould cleaning, packing and supervised production tasks.
Keep work areas and tools organised.
Follow PPE instructions and report hazards or damaged equipment.
qualification: No degree or high-school diploma required. Basic reading and counting are helpful; task and safety training will be provided.
experience: No previous experience required; reliable attendance and willingness to learn are essential.
skills: Ability to follow instructions and work with a team
Willingness to complete practical safety training
